summary: Light refactoring review completed for Issue #348 TaskFlow Engine implementation. The code quality is good overall with proper adherence to SOLID principles, appropriate error handling, and well-structured module separation. Key positive observations: 1) BaseNode abstract class implements Template Method pattern correctly, 2) Error classes follow SRP with clear separation between API errors and node execution errors, 3) Security features (SSRF protection, sandboxed JS execution) are well-implemented, 4) Workflow executor properly delegates to sequential/parallel executors. Minor suggestions for future iterations: 1) Extract duplicated workflow name regex to a constant in workflows.ts, 2) Consider renaming API-layer ApiError to HttpApiError to avoid confusion with node-layer ApiError. No blocking issues found - code is ready for iteration 1 completion.
